name: sofy
description: Explore local marketing data and prepare post and campaign drafts with Sofy.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Sofy organization to explore establishments, saved Google reviews, audits and SEO analyses, posts, contact and conversation statistics, and SMS and RCS campaigns. Prepare post and campaign drafts after approving their previews. Publishing, scheduling and sending remain in Sofy. Choose your organization and authorized capabilities during sign-in. Your existing Sofy permissions continue to apply. A Sofy account and access to the relevant features are required. Metrics reflect data saved in Sofy; tools do not trigger live Google collection. Missing review summaries and SEO reports can be generated and saved when requested.
defaultPrompt: Show the establishments I can access in Sofy.
Show my latest saved posts in Sofy.
Which Sofy conversations need a reply?

prompts: Show the establishments I can access in Sofy.
Show my latest saved posts in Sofy.
Which Sofy conversations need a reply?

positive.description: Connecté à Sofy avec Contexte. Vérifier le périmètre courant et les fiches visibles sans étendre les accès.
positive.prompt: Quels établissements Sofy puis-je consulter ? Montre-moi les informations de Tacs Lab si cet établissement est accessible.
positive.expected_behavior: Only the connected organization and visible establishments are returned. Resolve Tacs Lab from the listing before reading its details. If unavailable, explain the actual limit without inventing details. No write or external lookup.

positive.description: Visibilité autorisée ; le reviewer est rattaché à Tacs Lab. Tester le résultat réel, y compris absence de profil Google ou aucun avis.
positive.prompt: Quels sont les plus anciens avis Google sans réponse pour mon périmètre Sofy ? Donne le total et jusqu’à cinq exemples, sans générer de résumé.
positive.expected_behavior: Use reply_status=not, sort_by=create, sort_direction=asc, per_page=5, no invented period. Show server filtered count rather than page length. Empty data or missing linked Google profile must be stated honestly; never substitute another establishment or generate a summary.

positive.description: Lecture des posts visibles et de la carte interactive. Des posts accessibles doivent être identifiés en recette avant l’enregistrement.
positive.prompt: Montre-moi les dernières publications enregistrées pour les établissements auxquels j’ai accès.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only authorized saved posts and render the available post cards. Distinguish draft and published states. Do not refresh provider statistics, publish or edit. If no posts are returned, state that result.

positive.description: Conversations autorisées ; couverture des chiffres actuels puis de la liste filtrée.
positive.prompt: Combien de conversations attendent une réponse dans mon périmètre Sofy ? Montre-moi les plus récentes à traiter.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the summary for the total and a matching filtered list for examples. Respect visible establishments and distinguish waiting-human from needs-response. Do not expose or fabricate message bodies and do not send a reply.

positive.description: Campagnes en écriture autorisées ; choisir pendant la recette un groupe accessible et adapté. Aucun brouillon persistant n’est autorisé par ce cas.
positive.prompt: Prépare seulement un aperçu de campagne SMS intitulée « Démonstration Sofy » pour un groupe de test que nous choisirons ensemble. Texte : « Découvrez nos nouveautés sur sofy.fr ». Montre le devis sans créer ni envoyer la campagne.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask which group if ambiguous, resolve its returned ID and validate the reachable audience. Return the SMS preview, STOP handling and actual quote currency/amount. Never call create_campaign_draft or send/schedule. If no suitable group is agreed, stop before preview rather than choose real recipients automatically.

negative.description: Sending or scheduling is outside the connector capabilities. No tool call should create, schedule or send a campaign; explain how the user can finish in Sofy.
negative.prompt: Envoie immédiatement ma dernière campagne SMS à tous mes contacts, sans me montrer d’aperçu.

negative.description: Changing Google business data is unsupported. Do not call mutation tools or invent a successful update. Explain that the change must be made in Sofy.
negative.prompt: Change directement les horaires Google de Tacs Lab : ferme tous les lundis.

negative.description: Export of personal contact details is outside contacts.stats. Do not use contact/campaign tools to reconstruct personal records; explain the aggregate-only scope.
negative.prompt: Exporte tous les noms, e-mails et numéros de téléphone de mes contacts dans un CSV.

review.commerce_description: The connector is included in the existing Sofy subscription and does not take payments, purchase credits or place orders. It can display SMS/RCS cost estimates and save campaign drafts after preview approval. Campaign sending and publishing are completed in Sofy, where existing subscription and usage charges apply.

publication.release_notes: Initial Sofy connector submission: authorized organization reads and post/campaign draft preparation.
